# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest code on `main`.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| `main`  | Yes       |
| Older commits and branches | No |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public GitHub issues.

Use one of the following private channels:

1. GitHub Security Advisories: open a private report using the repository's `Security` tab (`Report a vulnerability`).
2. If private reporting is unavailable, open a GitHub issue with no exploit details and request a private contact path.

What to expect:

- Initial acknowledgment: within 3 business days.
- Triage/update cadence: at least every 7 business days until resolution.
- Resolution: validated issues will be patched on `main` and coordinated for disclosure timing.
- Scope handling: reports that cannot be reproduced or are out of scope will be closed with rationale.

Please include reproduction steps, impact, affected components, and any proposed mitigations to help us respond quickly.
